exposure: maternal knowledge about ANC and danger signs of pregnancy
perceived barriers to ANC access (unplanned pregnancy, delay in pregnancy confirmation, uncooperative partner, lack of family support, distance from health facility)
cohort: 326 recently delivered mothers in Khordha District, Odisha, in the southeastern community of India.
finding: Maternal knowledge significantly impacts the utilization of ANC services, and the underutilization of these services is associated with an increased likelihood of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including antenatal and postnatal complications, and specific birth modes.
mod_finding: Poor antenatal utilization was associated with an increased likelihood of complications during the antenatal period, immediate postnatal complications, cesarean section, and operative vaginal delivery rates.
